principles: Add standards and public/free capabilities when practical.
Keep paid providers disabled until credentials, pricing, limits, and user approval are available.
Never fake an integration as active; show Pending/Ready status instead.
Use server-side secrets only and protect platform OAuth scopes.

activationPolicy.free: Can be enabled when technically available without paid credentials and after build verification.
activationPolicy.pending: UI/config slot exists but execution remains disabled until required credentials, permissions and explicit approval are present.
activationPolicy.never: Do not expose fake success states or silently create billable usage.
